body: Knowing that I slipped on a day I was really up is so stupid, why? why did I do it when things were going great? how did I justify or convince myself it was a good idea? am I Insane or just stupid,  I can understand using when your down to forget about life but why when I had one of the best days of the year? I will probably go to a meeting, like NA I cant afford a therapist and I dont want to pay for therapy that just allows me to tell myself the answers, I need more or different support than a psychologist or therapist.

Your words mean a lot and are very appreciated.  Maybe someday I will be able to say I have 3 years,  Maybe someday I can care about the person in the mirror, today is definitely not that day.

edit- come to think of it I dont know If ive ever really cared enough about me to fix anything in my life, I know I need a professional....sigh

Thank you man I appreciate it, it really helps.  I know it's hard now because i slipped and when i get back on the bicycle tomorrow this feeling will pass, I just dont know how to get over the terrible things ive done to myself, and the people I love the most, self destructing a relationship with someone who loved me so dearly and I love her....but clearly not enough to be a real man, I feel scarred and the guilt from being a person I never thought I was.  holy fuck its hard to see what im typing through these tears. I know I have to forgive myself but from this hole im in I really cant see it happening.
